title: The Understudy WIP
description: Work-in-progress build of The Understudy, a new playable character for Slay the Spire 2. Shared for friend testing. Requires BaseLib.
changeNote: v1.12.21: Force-load each flank boss's map-node art before its node renders, so the real animated boss art shows instead of a blank node (the game only preloads the default boss's art). Includes diagnostics.
